en.headline: Cavalluna equestrian show opens tonight at Kai Tak Arena
en.dek: Europe’s large-scale horse theatre production makes its Asian debut with eight performances through 13 September, presented with the Hong Kong Jockey Club.
body: Cavalluna – Gate to the Otherworld begins its Hong Kong run at Kai Tak Arena this evening, marking the European equestrian spectacle’s first appearance in Asia. The production features 54 horses of multiple breeds, riders, dancers, original music and large-scale staging in a family-oriented theatrical format.

Performances are scheduled for 8 September at 7pm, followed by shows on 10, 11, 12 and 13 September at various afternoon and evening times. Tickets range from HK$395 for Category 3 seats to higher categories and VIP tables, with sales handled through the official channels of the Kai Tak Sports Park and the production.

The Hong Kong Jockey Club is the exclusive presenting partner and cultural host. The organisers describe the show as combining liberty work, formation riding and trick riding sequences within a narrative framework.

zh.headline: 歐洲馬術劇場Cavalluna今晚啟德首演
zh.dek: 大型馬術劇場《Cavalluna – 通往異世界之門》今晚起在啟德體藝館上演，一連五天共八場，為其亞洲首演。
body: 歐洲大型馬術劇場《Cavalluna – 通往異世界之門》今晚在啟德體藝館展開香港場次，標誌該製作首次登陸亞洲。演出匯集54匹不同品種馬匹、騎師、舞者、原創音樂及大型舞台設計，以家庭向劇場形式呈現。
場次包括9月8日晚上7時，以及10日至13日多個下午及晚上時段，合共八場。門票由395元起，至更高級別座位及貴賓桌，透過啟德體育園及製作方官方渠道發售。
香港賽馬會為獨家呈獻伙伴及文化主辦機構。主辦單位指演出結合自由馬術、隊形騎術及特技騎術，並以故事框架串連。
